text_block_list.text:
Today is the Fan Appreciation Festival! 
This year, Fenomeno is—

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
A synchronized finish! It's the 600m Pair 
Race!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for agreeing to 
participate! To think I'd get to run 
alongside the Boss in this event...!
choice_data_list: You really wanted to race that badly, huh?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes! My father is visiting today's Fan 
Thanksgiving Festival, so I want to show 
him!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Of course—the "bond between pairs"!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I've learned from countless detective 
dramas. Detectives work in pairs to solve 
cases... and together, the partners 
uncover the truth!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
And to this officer, you are my partner, 
Boss! And to you, Boss, your partner is 
me!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Just how well I've nurtured this bond 
with my precious partner... I want to burn 
it firmly into my professional father's 
eyes!"
choice_data_list: I-I see. So it's an event for pairs...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Let us prove through victory that our 
bond is the strongest in the academy!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'd like to get our 
preparations in order before our turn 
comes, but...
choice_data_list: Is this a strap for a three-legged race?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
? Something like that isn't necessary, 
—whoops.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Excuse me!

My hips lift, and my feet leave the 
ground. Th-This position is...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
The other teams are carrying their 
partners too, you know. There's a 
significant difference in leg strength 
compared to humans, after all.

Prompted by her words, I look around. 
Other pairs are giving piggyback rides, or 
carrying each other like sacks of rice...
choice_data_list: I'm telling you, that's not it!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Leave it to me! I take pride in knowing I 
can cherish the Boss better than any other 
pair!"
choice_data_list: Your father is watching too, right?!
Your father is watching too, right?!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's also a chance to show off just 
how strong your grown-up daughter's 
gotten!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Boss, wrap your arms around my neck so you 
don't fall off!

I pleaded with Fenomeno to please put me 
down just this once.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Boss? Um...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Was my support so unreliable that it made 
you rush like that...?
(*Bzzz, bzzz*)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Pardon me! An incoming call—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Hm? A LANE message from Dad... Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Boss, I apologize. My father wishes to 
take a photo of us participating in the 
competition.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
There was an inquiry about whether they 
could do a piggyback ride so that both of 
their faces would be facing forward...
choice_data_list: I see! Let's do that, then!!

text_block_list.name: Guide Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Alright, next group, please~! Line up in a 
single file~!

Breathing a sigh of relief, I take my 
position as guided. Then, slipping behind 
Fenomeno—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Here we go! Boss!

As Fenomeno accelerates, the biting cold 
wind slams directly into my cheeks.

Matching the rhythmic, powerful 
vibrations, the surrounding scenery 
whipped past in a flash. In the blink of 
an eye, my view shiftedâ
—Fenomeno's speed shifted up another gear.

...The photo of me running with Fenomeno 
from that time is still on display in the 
Trainer's Room to this day.

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text: The winner is Team Fenomeno!!
choice_data_list: We did it! Fenomeno, you're number one!
We did it! Fenomeno, you're number one!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes. However, um—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry, Boss!!
choice_data_list: Why?! That's the best possible result!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"N-No, you're mistaken. I, uh, despite 
carrying you, I just couldn't help—"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...I am terribly sorry! I will go pour 
cold water over my head!!
And Fenomeno ran off...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Puhaah! —Whew...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ......It's still hot. Still—...
"...Your running really is incredible."
“...Your running truly is incredible.”

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ――... Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...It's not a matter of 'more', is it— 
when you're carrying the Boss on your 
back...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Do not become foolish.
